blocks.title: Class P
blocks.text: Class P un masail ka majmooa hai jinhein computer polynomial waqt mein, deterministic algorithm (saaf qadam jo hamesha durust nateeje tak le jayein) se kaarkardagi se hal kar sake.

Misal: [4, 1, 3, 2, 5] ko [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] mein lagana. Computer pehle adad ka doosre se muwazna kar ke zaroorat ho to jagah badal sakta, agle jore par ja kar dohra sakta, aur list ke tarteeb mein aane tak jari rakh sakta hai. 5 se 10 adad karne par waqt barhta hai magar maqool had mein rehta hai.

Kitab kehti hai ke list dugni karne se waqt taqreeban dugna hota hai. Yeh sirf linear kaam ke liye theek hai: O(n log n) sort dugne se kuch zyada leta hai, aur bubble sort, O(n^2), taqreeban chaar guna; yeh sab phir bhi polynomial hain.

blocks.prompt: Kaunsi complexity class deterministic algorithm se kaarkardagi se hal hone wale masail ki hai (MCQ 2)?

items: P: saaf deterministic qadmon se jaldi (polynomial waqt) hal; sorting P mein hai.
